gloss: staggered work hours; flexible commuting times

definitions.gloss: staggered work hours; commuting outside rush hour
definitions.explanation: a work arrangement where employees start and end work at non-standard times to avoid rush hour congestion

examples.japanese: {時差出勤|じさしゅっきん}で{通勤|つうきん}ラッシュを{避|さ}ける。
examples.english: Avoid the commuter rush with staggered work hours.

examples.japanese: {時差出勤|じさしゅっきん}を{利用|りよう}して7{時|じ}に{出社|しゅっしゃ}する。
examples.english: I use staggered hours and go to the office at 7.

examples.japanese: コロナ{禍|か}で{時差出勤|じさしゅっきん}が{広|ひろ}まった。
examples.english: Staggered work hours spread during the COVID pandemic.

notes:
MODERN WORK TERM:
{時差出勤|じさしゅっきん} combines {時差|じさ} (time difference) + {出勤|しゅっきん} (going to work). It allows employees to avoid crowded trains.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {早朝|そうちょう}{出勤|しゅっきん} - early morning start (7:00-8:00)
- {遅|おそ}め{出勤|しゅっきん} - later start (10:00-11:00)
- フレックス{制|せい}との{併用|へいよう} - combined with flextime

BENEFITS:
- {混雑|こんざつ}{回避|かいひ} - avoiding crowds
- {感染症対策|かんせんしょうたいさく} - disease prevention
- {通勤|つうきん}ストレス{軽減|けいげん} - reduced commuting stress
- {生産性向上|せいさんせいこうじょう} - increased productivity

CULTURAL NOTE:
Particularly relevant in Japan where {通勤|つうきん}ラッシュ (commuter rush) is extremely crowded, especially in Tokyo and Osaka.

RELATED WORDS:
- フレックス{制|せい} - flextime
- ハイブリッド{勤務|きんむ} - hybrid work
- {通勤|つうきん}ラッシュ - commuter rush
- オフピーク{通勤|つうきん} - off-peak commuting
